description: Columbus, MS — Sixteen years ago today, the Affordable Care Act (ACA) gave millions of Mississippians access to health coverage they'd never had. Today, that progress is being dismantled — and Senator Cindy Hyde-Smith has had her hand on the wrecking ball since she arrived in Washington.
